headline: IBIT took in $665M in a day, lifting ETF net inflows to $527M on 10/19 — the biggest in a month; weighted funding eased to 8.13%, so this time spot is running ahead of leverage.
summary: BTC closed Tuesday at 82,936, at 82% of the day's range, on 0.97× the 20-day average volume. Two sources put 10/19 ETF flows at about +$527M (provisional, all IBIT), though the last 7 complete trading days are still −$451M. Weighted funding fell from 9.77% to 8.13% and DVOL dropped to its 16th 1-year percentile, but the 30-day risk reversal is −3.3 and options still lean toward downside protection. Market stage remains Bull (day 12); no exit-framework rule has fired or is close. Next to watch: whether ETF inflows continue, oil and the 10-year yield, and the 10/27–28 FOMC.

news.title: US spot BTC ETFs took in about $527M on 10/19 (Farside 526.7, SoSoValue 526.6), the most since 9/22; IBIT +$665M was the only fund with inflows, FBTC −$83.6M, GBTC −$54.9M
news.read: The site has logged 10/19 as a provisional value (the two sources differ by far less than 2%); The Block's figure will overwrite it automatically. One day cut October's net outflow from about −$615M to about −$88M, but the last 7 complete trading days are still −$451M and the Coinbase premium is −0.108%, with inflows concentrated in one fund; it takes several positive days in a row to say spot demand is back. A funding improvement, not a framework condition.

news.title: Oil spiked to six-month highs intraday Tuesday then reversed (Brent closed −0.7%); long-end Treasury yields fell ~5bp with the 10-year near 5.11%, while the 2-year rose ~2bp; the Dow +1%, Nasdaq flat
news.read: Lower oil eased long-end rate pressure, but the short end rose, and CME FedWatch still shows ~93.6% odds of at least one more hike by year-end (cited by FXBus, unverified) — the rate backdrop has not loosened. FRED 10-year 5.15% and real yield 2.80% (10/19) remain elevated; with 30-day Nasdaq correlation at 0.597, BTC still closed higher on a flat tech day. Macro backdrop; it touches neither the 200-day MA (−12.4%) nor any exit condition.

news.title: Asian chip stocks tumbled (Kospi −3.73%, lowest close since April) and BTC slipped back to 81,400 in Asia; on Deribit, puts outtraded calls more than two to one over 24 hours, with the 10/30 $80,000 put the busiest contract
news.read: Consistent with the site's 30-day risk reversal of −3.3 (puts 37.82 vs calls 34.53): options are buying downside protection, yet the same day funding fell to 8.13% and BTC closed at 82,936 — hedging demand did not become spot selling. The 10/30 monthly expiry holds 35.3% of OI with max pain 78,000 — a short-term volatility source that does not change the cycle view.

news.title: BlackRock filed with the SEC for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (PBIT): capped upside via IBIT options with roughly 10% downside protection per tranche, holding no BTC directly
news.read: The product widens the on-ramp for traditional money, but it holds only options and won't affect ETF flows before launch; no direct site metric — medium-term institutional backdrop that changes no call.

news.title: J.P. Morgan Asset Management issued its first long-term BTC return assumption: 10% a year over the next decade in the base case, −9.7% bear, 17% bull (US large caps 7.5%, gold 5.5%)
news.read: A major asset manager putting BTC into long-term allocation assumptions is a background signal of institutional acceptance, though it stresses that volatility and unstable correlations limit allocation size; no direct bearing on the site's cycle view, not a trading signal.

news.title: Mideast attacks continued and Hormuz shipping was disrupted; Brent rose above $111 early Tuesday, its highest since May; analysts mostly expect the Fed to hold this month with hikes still possible by year-end
news.read: High oil is a main driver of yields and hike expectations; oil reversed by the close and BTC closed higher. Background pressure on risk appetite; it doesn't change the market stage or the exit framework.

items.title: Quantifying Support and Resistance: Proximity-Weighted CBD
items.points: Builds proximity support/resistance indices (PSI/PRI) and proximity MVRV/NUPL by weighting the cost-basis distribution by distance from spot; reviews how a 83.6K–85.4K resistance band built above spot in spring 2026 before the drop into the low 60Ks, and how PSI weakened on the 85.5K/86.6K retests in Dec 2025/Jan 2026; no current 10/20 readings given.
items.meaning: Methodology piece with no current readings — not used as a basis for judgment; its historical 83.6K–85.4K resistance band sits near the site's URPD cluster of ~1.16M BTC at 84–86K (different data vendors, comparison only).
